packcompanion.machine.thread_hatch.toolt:
Allows the attached multiblock to run multiple independent recipes at once (true multithreading).
One recipe is only handled by a single thread; use a Parallel Hatch for duplicates.
Energy draw scales with active threads.
packcompanion.multiblock.thread.occupied: Thread #%s: idle (recipe already handled by another thread)
packcompanion.multiblock.thread.io_block: Thread #%s: idle (insufficient power / inputs / output room)
packcompanion.multiblock.thread.occupied: %s of them idle because the recipe is duplicated on other threads
packcompanion.multiblock.thread.queued: · queued for power (draw drained by other threads this tick)
